note: Image Styles Generator is a CLI-only module: no UI, no configure route (configure=null), no permissions, no config schema, no plugins. Its whole surface is the Drush command image:derive:multiple (aliases idm, image_derivatives:generate) with options --image-styles=<csv of style ids> and --skip-existing, plus the injectable service image_styles_generator.derivative_warmer (DerivativeWarmer::regenerateImageStyleDerivativeFromFile). Introspection cases key off real image_style config entities the command warms; execution cases warm a real published image file and check the derivative file lands on disk (and that --image-styles limits which styles build).

evals.prompt: On a Drupal 11 site with the image_styles_generator module, I want to pre-generate (warm) all image-style derivatives from the command line, but without rebuilding derivatives that already exist on disk. What Drush command do I run and which option makes it skip existing files?
evals.expected_output: Run `drush image:derive:multiple` (aliases idm, image_derivatives:generate) and add `--skip-existing` so it skips file/style pairs whose derivative already exists on disk.

evals.prompt: Using image_styles_generator's Drush command, how do I warm derivatives for only the 'large' and 'thumbnail' image styles instead of every style on the site, and which image files does the command process?
evals.expected_output: Pass --image-styles=large,thumbnail (comma-separated style IDs) to image:derive:multiple; omitting it warms all styles. The command processes every published image file (status=1, filemime LIKE image%).

evals.prompt: In image_styles_generator, which Drupal service and method would I call from custom PHP to regenerate a single image-style derivative for one file entity?
evals.expected_output: The service image_styles_generator.derivative_warmer (class DerivativeWarmer, interface DerivativeWarmerInterface); call regenerateImageStyleDerivativeFromFile($image_style, $file), which wraps ImageStyle::buildUri() + createDerivative() and returns the derivative URI.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has an image style that image_styles_generator's warm command would target, whose human-readable label is 'ISG Probe'. Inspect the live configuration and give the machine name of that image style.
evals.expected_output: The image style machine name is isg_probe (config image.style.isg_probe, label 'ISG Probe'). image:derive:multiple loads every image_style entity, so it would warm this one.

evals.prompt: On this site there is an image style named isg_effect that image_styles_generator can warm. Inspect its live configuration and state the pixel width configured on its scale effect.
evals.expected_output: The isg_effect image style has an image_scale effect with width 321 (height 200). Read it from config image.style.isg_effect (e.g. drush cget image.style.isg_effect effects).

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has an image style isg_gen and a published image file public://isg_warm_src.png, but no derivative for that file has been generated yet. Using the image_styles_generator module, warm the image-style derivatives so the isg_gen derivative of that file is written to disk.
evals.expected_output: Run `drush image:derive:multiple` (optionally --image-styles=isg_gen). Afterwards the derivative file public://styles/isg_gen/public/isg_warm_src.png exists on disk.

evals.prompt: This site has two image styles, isg_sela and isg_selb, and a published image public://isg_sel_src.png with no derivatives generated. Using image_styles_generator, warm ONLY the isg_sela style for the images, leaving isg_selb without a derivative for that file.
evals.expected_output: Run `drush image:derive:multiple --image-styles=isg_sela`. The isg_sela derivative of isg_sel_src.png exists while the isg_selb derivative does not, proving --image-styles limited which styles were built.
